headline: Revenue and margins surge as profitability turns positive
summary_short: Lumentum (LITE US) reported FY2026 Q1 revenue of $808.4M, up 21.5% q/q and up 90.1% y/y; net income was $144.2M, versus a $44.1M net loss a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue was $808.4M, up 21.5% q/q and up 90.1% y/y. Gross margin expanded to 44.2% from 36.1% q/q and 28.8% y/y. Diluted EPS was $1.50, up 68.5% q/q, versus a $0.64 loss per share y/y. Net income was $144.2M versus a $44.1M net loss y/y. Cash and short-term investments totaled $3,172.3M, up from $1,155.3M q/q and $866.7M y/y.
